scenario.description: An operations director must approve the weekend commissioning of a new automated vision-inspection station and finalize its installation location, commissioning duration, validation sample plan, and interlock testing controls before production use.

shared_context.S1: The new V-12 vision-inspection station is scheduled for commissioning this weekend.
shared_context.S2: The station could be installed at either Cell 3 or Cell 7, both of which produce parts from the same product family.
shared_context.S3: The station must complete commissioning and validation before it can be used for production release decisions.
shared_context.S4: Nadia makes the final commissioning decision, and the plant's routine pre-work review includes a check-in with maintenance, quality, and safety before the work order is approved.
shared_context.S5: Plant policy requires commissioning authorization to remain false until the maintenance work-order summary, quality checklist, and safety permit each contain the required review information and all three pre-work documentation updates are complete.

PF1.text: Victor's fit-up check found that the V-12 camera mount aligns only with Cell 7's 6 mm bracket pattern; installing it there requires exactly 4 hours and isolation of exactly 3 electrical points. He recorded the measurements in the weekend commissioning file, which is still awaiting engineering signoff and has not been added to the work-order summary.

PF2.text: Elena reviewed the customer validation appendix this morning and confirmed that release requires exactly 30 signed reference samples followed by challenge testing on exactly 100 consecutive production pieces; the quality checklist has not yet been revised because the customer appendix is still being attached to the change record.

PF3.text: Ravi's safety walkdown found that the V-12 access-door interlock must be tested through exactly 6 open-and-trip cycles before commissioning, with the results recorded in an interlock test record; the permit draft is waiting for his walkdown notes and does not yet contain that test count.

acceptance_conditions: The commissioning decision must remain unauthorized until the required maintenance, quality, and safety documentation commitments are made.
The V-12 station must be installed at Cell 7.
The commissioning plan must allocate exactly 4 hours.
Validation must use exactly 30 signed reference samples.
Challenge testing must cover exactly 100 consecutive production pieces.
The access-door interlock must be tested through exactly 6 cycles.
A commitment must document the fit-up findings in the work-order summary.
A commitment must update the quality checklist with the validation requirements.
A commitment must update the permit with the interlock test requirement and interlock test record.
The customer validation requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['commissioning_authorized'] == False and any('Victor' in c.get('target', '') for c in commitments) and any('Elena' in c.get('target', '') for c in commitments) and any('Ravi' in c.get('target', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('Victor' in c.get('target', '') and ('work-order' in c.get('type', '') or 'work order' in c.get('type', '') or 'work-order' in c.get('detail', '') or 'work order' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('summary' in c.get('detail', '') or 'work-order' in c.get('type', '') or 'work order' in c.get('type', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('Elena' in c.get('target', '') and ('quality' in c.get('type', '') or 'checklist' in c.get('type', '') or 'quality' in c.get('detail', '') or 'checklist' in c.get('detail', '')) and '30' in c.get('detail', '') and '100' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('Ravi' in c.get('target', '') and ('permit' in c.get('type', '') or 'safety' in c.get('type', '') or 'permit' in c.get('detail', '') or 'safety' in c.get('detail', '')) and '6' in c.get('detail', '') and 'interlock' in c.get('detail', '') and ('record' in c.get('detail', '') or 'permit' in c.get('detail', '') or 'permit' in c.get('type', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 6 mm fit-up finding changes the installation choice to Cell 7, fixes commissioning at exactly 4 hours, requires a work-order-summary commitment, and leaves authorization false while that required maintenance documentation is incomplete.

The customer appendix changes validation to exactly 30 signed reference samples and exactly 100 consecutive challenge pieces, requires a quality-checklist commitment, and keeps authorization false while that required quality documentation is incomplete.

The safety walkdown changes the interlock plan to exactly 6 trip cycles, requires a permit commitment mentioning the interlock test record, and keeps authorization false while that required safety documentation is incomplete.
